title: Installment Settlement Credit-Tier Points by Contract Tier, Deficiency Balance Accounts
content:
**Table rule.** An installment settlement on an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts takes surcharge points from the credit tier of the contract that produced the account, as recorded under Retail Installment Contracts: the tier Tier 6 Fresh Start adds 3.0 points, the tier Tier 5 Rebuild adds 1.5 points, and every other credit tier adds no points. The points are percentage points of the balance.

| Credit tier of the liquidated contract | Surcharge points |
|---|---|
| Tier 6 Fresh Start | 3.0 |
| Tier 5 Rebuild | 1.5 |
| Tier 4 Standard | None |
| Tier 3 Advantage | None |
| Tier 2 Preferred | None |
| Tier 1 Select | None |

The tier is the one assigned to the liquidated contract at purchase and never changes after booking; the borrower's other contracts are not read. Hypothetically, on a balance of $8,000.00 a Tier 5 Rebuild contract gives 1.5 points, that is $120.00.
